warning: Draft annotations have not been independently human reviewed. This measures extraction, not factual verification or guaranteed coverage. Heldout fixtures are public local examples, not a sealed external test set.

metric_definitions.exact_boundary: Micro precision/recall with exact start, end, and original text; one prediction can match only one gold annotation.
metric_definitions.classification: Category/checkability accuracy only among exactly matched claims with a predicted label; misses are reported separately.
metric_definitions.false_supported: Count/rate of premature SUPPORTED labels in extraction-only output without independent evidence; not an estimate of verifier accuracy.
metric_definitions.empty_denominator: null means unavailable; never substitute 100% for an empty denominator.

unavailable_measurements.verification_precision_and_recall: Not run: evidence verification is not implemented in Level 1.
unavailable_measurements.citation_validity: Not run: extraction recognizes text only and does not fetch citations.
unavailable_measurements.abstention_quality: Not run: requires evidence-based gold verdicts; extraction-only UNVERIFIED is not measured as successful abstention.
unavailable_measurements.numerical_checking_accuracy: Not run: calculation verification belongs to a later level.
unavailable_measurements.ordinary_llm_judge_baseline: Not run: requires configured model credentials, explicit cost budget, and a separate verification dataset.
unavailable_measurements.original_trustlayer_baseline: Not comparable for extraction: the existing sycophancy detector does not output atomic claim spans or factual verdicts. Its regressions are tested separately.
